name: vaultguard-ai
description: VaultGuard AI — Privacy-First Customer Data Protection Infrastructure & Explainable AI Security Sentinel

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@vaultguard/crypto-core && npm run build --workspace=@vaultguard/node
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@vaultguard/api && npm run build --workspace=@vaultguard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@vaultguard/crypto-core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@vaultguard/node && npm run typecheck --workspace=@vaultguard/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@vaultguard/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
